result.reason: The skill reads and searches email correspondence, sends message bodies and attachments to recipients, and persists email account credentials in local configuration. Email addresses, correspondence, and attachments reasonably contain personal information.

evidence.quote: description: Read and send email via IMAP/SMTP. Check for new/unread messages, fetch content, search mailboxes, mark as read/unread, and send emails with attachments. Supports multiple accounts. Works with any IMAP/SMTP server including Gmail, Outlook, 163.com, vip.163.com, 126.com, vip.126.com, 188.com, and vip.188.com.

Configuration is stored at `~/.config/mail-skills/.env` (shared with caldav-sync skill, survives skill updates). If no shared config is found, the skill checks `~/.config/imap-smtp-email/.env` (legacy) and then a `.env` file in the skill directory.

### Config file format (shared)

```bash
# Default account
PROVIDER=163
USERNAME=your@163.com
PASSWORD=your_password
